text:
sam: Heads-up — ran the onboarding stress harness for the JS sampleapp and hit a bad interaction between prefetch + pagination. We got a short burst of 429s and the client kept queuing pages; memory climbed. Repro: new org, ~18 concurrent users, prefetch enabled. :grimace:

amy: ack. which language sampleapp? any logs or config?

sam: nextjs (js sdk). logs show repeated `WARN page-fetch status=429` and a growing inflight queue. Config used:

```
page_size: 40
prefetch: 6
client_window: 20
max_concurrency: 10
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 3
  base_backoff_ms: 150
```

kelvin: parity note — go/python clients use a smoothing token-bucket that naturally limits prefetch. JS currently uses a semaphore and doesn't reduce aggressive prefetch when backend returns 429. That mismatch explains differential behavior.

amy: two-pronged plan: (1) short-term sampleapp mitigation — clamp prefetch based on client_window + a small circuit that pauses prefetch on sustained 429s, and (2) upstream SDK parity fix to add smoothing semantics (or document the difference).

sam: prototyped a small clamp locally: `const clamp = Math.max(1, Math.floor(config.client_window / 5)); prefetch = Math.min(config.prefetch, clamp);` That reduced the 429 spike and stabilized memory in my run.

kelvin: also make retries exponential with jitter and notify the prefetch controller on repeated 429s so it reduces the effective window (eg halve for 30s). We should add a circuit that pauses prefetch if 429 rate >15% over 20s and backoff gradually.

amy: please gate debug features behind an env var. Add header `X-RW-Prefetch-Debug: true` when `DEBUG_PREFETCH=true` to log inflight/pending counts for support.

ci-bot: integration tests for `devex/sampleapp` reported a flaky prefetch_flow test: https://ci/reports/4982

amy: Sam, add a deterministic e2e harness that fakes 429 responses so CI can validate behavior without timing flakiness.

sam: will do. Opening a draft PR that includes clamp + circuit + debug header + synthetic e2e: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/530 (WIP). ETA: EOD.

kelvin: filing an SDK parity ticket: recommend either switch JS to token-bucket smoothing or add an explicit prefetch controller API so sample apps can implement the same semantics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1042 (tagging @sdk-team).

amy: short-term docs note: recommend `prefetch: 1` for small orgs during onboarding until we ship a robust fix. Add an entry in the client-side throttling doc describing clamping and circuit rules.

sam: I'll add a telemetry metric `prefetch_pauses` and update the changelog to mark this as experimental. Will ping when PR is up.

kelvin: follow-up — add a low-cost server-side mitigation: when a new org shows heavy prefetch patterns, throttle connections from that org slightly for the first minute to avoid hot cache stampedes. Ops can opt-out.

amy: good idea. Also add a support-runbook checklist: how to set `prefetch: 1`, flip `DEBUG_PREFETCH`, and gather debug header logs.

sam: thanks team. I'll post PR and the runbook snippet once ready.
